items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Scott Joplin or W. C. Handy, none of them.

ctx.x: (More like) They called it hot music. They called it hot stuff, hot music, jazz. And, you know, the funny part, I was telling my wife Dorothe that I didn't know Scott Joplin was a colored man. All them many years I didn't know he was a colored man. And my uncle used to send away for his books, you know, because he had all these -- like, for the band, you know, for instance, like for the trumpet, trombone, clarinet, and all that. He sent out for the set, Scott Joplin tunes.
